messages:
Olga R: hi team, i'm Olga, started today on growth. need quick access to Console staging to toggle the "onboarding-ux" feature flag for a smoke test. who grants this? :wave:
Gabe M: welcome Olga! tag me. i can grant a 24h staging flag admin. do you also need grafana/staging metrics?
Olga R: yes please, grafana view would help to watch CTR and error rates.
Gabe M: i'll grant flags-admin-staging + staging-observability for 24h. command i run:
```
rbac grant --user olga.r --roles flags-admin-staging,staging-observability --ttl 24h --reason "onboarding smoke test"
```
Infra-Bot: Access event recorded: user=olga.r action=grant roles=[flags-admin-staging,staging-observability] ttl=24h actor=gabe.m id=evt_1788888888
Taylor P: quick note: staging toggles are okay without tickets but include a short note in the experiment ticket and attach screenshots. do not flip prod without a change ticket + 2 approvers.
Olga R: got it, thanks Gabe and Taylor. i'll run the 5% rollout in ~30m and post results here.
Gabe M: sounds good, ping me when you flip and i'll watch the metrics. :thumbsup:
